Subject: Request: press & guest access for BrightBridge webinar + trial extension

Hi Aditya / Marissa,

Hope you’re both well — BrightBridge is running a partner webinar next Monday (7/05) with ~1,200 registrants. We have two late asks and wanted to check feasibility:  

1) One complimentary press guest from TechPress (Olivia Park) — needs a single live/demo access pass and short speaker Q&A seat.
2) A 30-day trial extension / 20 on-demand trial codes for post-event viewers (we’ll gate the recording behind a trial).

Attachment: event_schedule.pdf (agenda + expected timings).

Can you confirm if Redwood can provide the pass and issue a small pool of time-limited trial promo codes? If there are cost or billing approvals needed, please call it out — deadline for promo codes is EOD Wednesday so we can embed the code in the post-event landing page.

Thanks,
Natalie
Partnerships — BrightBridge Media

Hi Natalie — thanks for the heads up. Quick read-through below and a proposed approach:  

- Press guest: we can provision one speaker/pass-level account for Olivia for the live demo (no additional cost). Please confirm Olivia's full name for the access badge.
- Trial codes: provisional approval for 20 on-demand trial codes, 30-day extension from code redemption. We need final sign-off from Finance to absorb to marketing budget (cost center MA-2026-PART).

Marissa / Laura — can you confirm the promo_code naming and whether Marketing will cover the cost? If yes I’ll generate the codes and send to Natalie. If Finance needs an invoice or internal chargeback note, Laura please advise.

I’m happy to limit redemption to one per account and set expiry to 8/31/2026.

—Aditya
